alignment: Complete monotone object-path alignment, including translation and rotation; no fitted spatial transform. Both endpoints included. Video clocks show original recording times.
human_object_reference: Original target trajectory scaled for G1
plot: 3D object-center paths; purple human reference, teal physical robot execution.
rendering: Blender Cycles, 48 samples, OptiX denoising. Direct mesh renders of saved motions, not upscaled source videos.
human_pose_registration: At each human timestamp, translate the entire human mesh by fixed target object position minus original human object position. Human joint poses, rotations and dimensions remain unchanged. Registration does not use the robot execution.

aligned_takeaway_pair.rendering: Blender Cycles, 48 samples, OptiX denoising. Separate direct renders with the same camera and framing.
aligned_takeaway_pair.human_motion: Original recorded human mesh poses and object poses, in the source coordinate frame.
aligned_takeaway_pair.timing: Both clips use the same 576-frame monotone object-path alignment as the overlay. Neither uses a fixed 2x speed multiplier.
aligned_takeaway_pair.playback: Linked play, pause, seeking, speed and looping.

background.rendering: Transparent Blender world and shadow-catching floor composited onto the takeaway background. The table remains visible.
background.unchanged: Recorded motion, alignment, cameras, geometry, object-path data and scores.
